    return p@base('classifier.out_proj.weight').T+base('classifier.out_proj.bias')

# L5 pruning, CV by id (5 folds), fit on both base+edited samples
def l5_cv(m, lam_rel, A_eval, H_eval, src='both'):
    out=np.zeros((1000,4))
    sc_all=None
    for f in range(5):
        tr=folds!=f; te=folds==f
        Htr=np.r_[Hb[tr],He[tr]] if src=='both' else Hb[tr]
        sc=Htr.var(0)*(W2**2).sum(0); order=np.argsort(-sc); keep=np.sort(order[:m]); drop=order[m:]
        T=Htr[:,drop]@W2[:,drop].T; X=Htr[:,keep]; mu=X.mean(0); Xc=X-mu; G=Xc.T@Xc
        B=np.linalg.solve(G+lam_rel*np.trace(G)/m*np.eye(m), Xc.T@(T-T.mean(0)))
        W2n=np.zeros_like(W2); W2n[:,keep]=W2[:,keep]+B.T; b2n=b2+T.mean(0)-mu@B
        out[te]=headf(ln(A_eval[te]+H_eval[te]@W2n.T+b2n))
    return out
